name: Ornn
title: The Fire below the Mountain

Q.name: Volcanic Rupture
Q.description: Ornn slams the ground, creating a fissure dealing 20/45/70/95/120 + 1.1×AD physical damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds. A pillar of rock forms at the fissure's end for 4 seconds.
Q.summary: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.

W.name: Bellows Breath
W.description: Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing 12/13/14/15/16% max Health magic damage over 0.75 seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for 3 seconds. Immobilizing effects on Brittle targets have their duration increased by 30% and deal an additional 0.09–0.17 (by level) max Health magic damage. Ornn's Attacks against Brittle targets Knock them Back, dealing the additional damage.
W.summary: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.

E.name: Searing Charge
E.description: Ornn charges, dealing 80/125/170/215/260 + 0.4×bonus armor + 0.4×bonus MR physical damage. If Ornn rams into terrain, he creates a shockwave that Knocks Up enemies for 1.25 seconds and applies the same damage to those not hit by the charge. Ornn's charge destroys magma pillars and terrain created by enemies.
E.summary: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.

R.name: Call of the Forge God
R.description: Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing 125/175/225 + 0.2×AP magic damage, applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by 40/50/60% for 3 seconds. Ornn can Recast to dash with a headbutt. If he dashes into the elemental, he redirects and empowers it, causing it to Knock Up the first champion for 1 second and subsequent champions for (1 × 0.5) seconds. The elemental also deals 125/175/225 + 0.2×AP magic damage and reapplies Brittle.
R.summary: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.

Passive.name: Living Forge
Passive.description: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources. Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere. Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.
Passive.summary: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources. Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere. Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Tank who trades with W brittle + Q pillar + E charge into terrain, upgrades his team's items and leads teamfights with R.
strengths: Strong crowd-control chain: Q pillar → E knock-up, brittle procs
W makes enemies Brittle (empowered next attack knock-up, %HP damage)
Upgrades items for the whole team
Very durable; buys anywhere without backing
weaknesses: E knock-up needs terrain or his pillar
profile.curveNote: Trades with W into brittle auto; all-in combo needs Q pillar + E.

Passive.notes: Bonus resists; forge items; masterwork upgrades.

Q.notes: Fissure slows; creates pillar (terrain for E).

W.notes: Advances breathing fire; Brittle makes his next attack/crowd control proc a knock-up (check).

E.notes: Charge; knock-up only if he hits terrain or pillar.

R.notes: Elemental slows + Brittle; recast to headbutt for knock-up.

profile.windowAgainst: No pillar/wall nearby (E has no knock-up) or after E is used.
checks: W Brittle auto knock-up detail: check
